title: 1RB0LC_1LA1RF_1LD0LE_1RE0RA_1LC0RD_0RE---: when the last run is used up, a reflector rebuilds the list and triples it
text: Each end of a drain starts a rebuild: the head bounces between the right end and a reflector Q that walks left two cells per bounce (proved in Lean for every size), and every separator Q passes is carried right four cells per bounce, so the blocks it passes come out three times longer (3n or 3n±4). A walk ends when the first mover reaches the right end, leaving a scar that later walks pass or stop at. Eight drain ends were watched to 6·10<sup>14</sup> steps (five in direct simulation), all rebuilds; some reach the left end and turn the reservoir itself into blocks. Every halt would be the head in D, moving right, on 1 0 1 1.
